July 14, 1938.
（手写批注：KMT）
（印章：mps JULY 1938）

LAINICHI

FRENCH MUNICIPAL COUNCIL RECRUITS POLICEMEN AMONG
REFUGEES FROM REFUGEE SHELTERS WHICH ARE BREWING
PLACES OF ANTI-JAPANESE ACTIVITIES

The International Settlement Police
and the French Municipal Police have been widely criticized
because of their powerlessness to suppress the anti-Japanese
terrorists who have come to Shanghai on the instructions
of the Hankow Government to create disturbances in
Shanghai by attacking important pro-Japanese Chinese and
Japanese organizations. The two Police forces have
now suddenly adopted precautionary measures to suppress
these terrorists, although we do not know why they have
suddenly decided to do so.

According to information received
from a certain source, the French Municipal Police have
recruited over 20 refugees from refugee shelters which
are the brewing places of insubordinate elements and the
centre of plottings. The recruits will undergo three
months training in police duties.

This plan of the French Municipal
authorities, who are responsible for the maintenance
of peace and order, to place elements who have been in
contact with terrorists in the front line for the
maintenance of peace and order, will greatly affect
the situation in future when an incident occurs.
For this reason, a close watch is now being kept on the
situation.

（左侧盖章及手写：FILE 2csb / 308 14/7）
P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

（右侧手写签名及职务：
Comme

(SPECIAL BRANCH)

1938年7月14日。
（手写批注：国民党）
（印章：mps 1938年7月）

莱尼奇（LAINICHI，音译）

法租界公董局从难民收容所中招募警察，
而该等收容所乃反日活动之策源地

公共租界巡捕房与法租界巡捕房因无力镇压奉汉口政府指令来沪、
通过袭击重要的亲华及亲日组织以在上海制造骚乱的反日恐怖分子，
而受到广泛批评。这两支警力现已突然采取预防措施以镇压这些恐怖分子，
尽管我们尚不知晓其突然决定此举的原因。

据某方面消息，法租界巡捕房已从难民收容所中招募了20余名难民，
而这些收容所是不法分子的策源地及阴谋策划的中心。
被招募者将接受为期三个月的警务训练。

负责维持治安的法租界当局，竟将与恐怖分子有接触的人员置于
维持治安的第一线，这一计划将在未来发生事件时极大地影响局势。
鉴于此，目前正对局势保持严密监视。

（左侧盖章及手写：档案 2csb / 308 14/7）

File No............
Special Branch - S.l.Station,
REPORT
Date June 21, 19 38.

Subject Article appearing in Shanghai Nippo dated June 17, 1938.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by C. Crawford.

（左侧印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH / JUNE 1938）

in regard to the reference made in the attached
newspaper article to the French Police and the recruiting
of interned Chinese soldiers by that organization, Mr.
JOBEZ and Mr. MORET of the French Police have both been
interviewed in this connection. They state that this
article has already been the subject of enquiries by the
French Police but the information contained therein is
definitely incorrect. In the last batch of Chinese
recruited for the French Police however, were a number
of former detectives and uniformed members of the now
defunct Police Bureau of the Shanghai City Government.
They were recruited in accordance with the usual manner
as enforced in the French Police, but on no occasion has
any interned soldier ever been **〔此处转录不清〕** into the ranks of
the French Police.

FILE
D.S.P.
21/6.

（中间印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 22 JUNE 1938 / COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

D.C. (Special Branch).

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.

日期：1938年6月21日。

主题：关于1938年6月17日《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）刊登的文章。

由 D.S. Pitts 撰写。由 C. Crawford 转呈。

（左侧印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别处 / 1938年6月）

就附报文章中对法国巡捕房及该机构招募被拘禁中国士兵一事的提及，
已就此约谈了法国巡捕房的 JOBEZ 先生和 MORET 先生。
他们表示，法国巡捕房已对该文章进行了调查，但其中所载信息确属不实。
然而，在最近一批为法国巡捕房招募的中国人中，确有数名前侦探及制服警员，
他们来自现已解散的上海市政府警察局。
他们是按照法国巡捕房执行的常规方式被招募的，但从未有任何被拘禁士兵
被 **〔此处转录不清〕** 入法国巡捕房队伍之中。

存档
D.S.P.
6月21日。

（中间印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1938年6月22日 / 总监办公室）

A 17 10
CHIANG KAI SHEK ATTEMPTS TO PUT OWN MEN IN
FRENCH POLICE
17 JUN. 1938

The unfavourable feeling among
the Chinese people against Chiang Kai-shek is spreading like
a tidal wave, as Hankow is about to fall into the hands
of the Japanese Imperial Army. Thinking Chinese
are discouraged and have started a movement for peace.
Chiang Kai-shek is adopting
various measures to check this unfavourable feeling and to
crush the peace movement. For this purpose he has
detailed a number of insubordinate elements to Shanghai.
Some are reported to be active among Chinese financial
circles.

When Tan Li, leader of the
Blue Shirts Society, returned to Hankow from Shanghai,
Tsai Ching Chun, the former chief of the Chinese Police
Bureau at Nantao, who has great influence among the defeated
Chinese soldiers and loafers in the Foreign Settlements,
was ordered to proceed to Shanghai. One Chen, formerly
chief of the First Section of the Chinese Police Bureau at
Nantao, and another named Wei, formerly chief of the
Water Police, are reported to be waiting for a chance to do
something in the French Concession.

Learning that the French
authorities are finding it difficult financially to maintain the
1,000 interned Chinese soldiers under General Chang Fah-kwei,
the 500 ex-policemen of the Nantao Police Bureau and the 300
ex-members of the Peace Preservation Corps under General
Yang Fu, the anti-Japanese elements in Shanghai have made
a suggestion to the French Police to employ the interned
men as police recruits on the understanding that the
expenses are paid by the National Government. The French
Police recently took on 1,000 recruits and it is reported
that many of the interned men were amongst the number.
Close attention is being paid to the matter as it is regarded
as a plan of Chiang Kai-shek to put his men in the French
Police Force and to make use of them for creating disturbances.

D.S. Pol
C. 1/2
pages.zh:
A 17 10
蒋介石试图将其亲信安插进法国巡捕房
1938年6月17日

随着汉口即将落入日本帝国陆军之手，
中国民众对蒋介石的不满情绪如潮水般蔓延。
思想界人士感到气馁，并已发起和平运动。
蒋介石正采取各种措施以遏制这种不利情绪并粉碎和平运动。
为此，他已派遣一批不法分子前往上海。
据报道，其中一些人在中国金融界活动活跃。

当蓝衣社首领谭立（Tan Li，音译）从上海返回汉口时，
曾在南市中国警察局任职、在被击败的中国士兵及外国租界内的游民中
拥有巨大影响力的前局长蔡景春（Tsai Ching Chun，音译），
奉命前往上海。
据报道，前南市中国警察局第一科科长陈某，以及前水上警察局局长魏某，
正在法租界等待时机采取行动。

获悉法国当局在财政上难以维持张发奎将军麾下的1,000名被拘禁中国士兵、
南市警察局的前500名前警员以及杨虎（Yang Fu，音译）将军麾下
和平保全团（Peace Preservation Corps）的300名前成员后，
上海的反日分子向法国巡捕房建议，雇佣这些被拘禁人员作为警察 recruits，
条件是费用由国民政府承担。
法国巡捕房近期招募了1,000名新警，据报道其中有许多是被拘禁人员。
此事正受到密切关注，因为这被视为蒋介石将其亲信安插进法国巡捕房队伍、
并利用他们制造骚乱的计划。

D.S. Pol
C. 1/2
